limitations: Source inspection only. An independent agent must run V-C08 in a browser against this content before the article can leave review.

Device notifications need a browser that supports the Push API and a push service the lab can reach. A headless lab browser may show the unsupported message; the walkthrough should record which states it could reach.

Comment email tier names use the storage tier names (Legal Only, Working Team, Full Thread), while the thread badges on a Contract or Matter read Contract Team, Matter Team and Internal team. The guide reports both as built.
The Your approvals checks need a Contract Approval addressed to the acting person and, for the Administrator, an API key request.

productBugs.symptom: The Portal Assigned to you row text says 'Contract team additions and comments that mention you on your Contracts and Matters.' The same switches also control Contract Approval requests addressed to the Business User and decisions on their API key requests, which the text does not name.
productBugs.contradicts: NOT-001 and NOT-005 addenda 2026-09-23 (the Portal bell shows Your approvals to a Business User) and DD-029 (API key decisions in Assigned to you); the row copy is meant to name what the switches control (notification-preferences.tsx GROUP_COPY comment)

productBugs.symptom: The Key date dialog shows 'Global reminders' and 'This date will remind' from the organization's list only. A recipient who set their own Reminder lead times is reminded on their own list plus the Key date's lead times, so the preview is wrong for them.
productBugs.contradicts: NOT-004 addendum 2026-09-24 (a person's list replaces the default; a Key date's own lead times add to whichever list applies to each recipient)
